card.name: Inside route-of-administration words
card.fires_on: The middle of a long route or direction word, such as intramuscular, subcutaneous, intravenous, radial or peripherally, just before its ending or the following noun. Seen mostly in injection and dosing instructions.

modes.label: Injection route words
modes.description: Partway through intramuscular, subcutaneous or intravenous in administration instructions.

modes.label: Other directional terms
modes.description: Partway through words like radial or axial, or peripherally, in injection technique or other technical text.
